patches.name: Universal Overlay Patch v1.0 (Experimental)
patches.description:
Universal in-app overlay for Android apps and games. Optional modules include System Time, FPS,
fullscreen, app brightness, and haptic controls. Modules are excluded and disabled by default;
select them in Morphe settings before patching. Statistic modules show information, Activity modules
control the current Activity, and Hook modules control internal app behavior, such as disabling
animations, through best-effort runtime changes. A selected local image automatically replaces
the legacy icon; empty or invalid image input falls back to the legacy icon. This is experimental
and may not work on all apps.

The idea and initial works of this Universal Overlay Patch are from Zanuaimi / Noobite.

options.title: General - Overlay title
options.description: Title shown in the overlay menu. Limited to 80 characters.

options.title: General - Overlay description
options.description: Description below the title. Limited to 500 characters.
options.default:
Welcome! This is UniPatches Universal Overlay Patch Menu.
You will find modules below the description if you enabled some modules
in this patch settings before patching this APK.
The idea and initial works of Universal Overlay Patch are from Zanuaimi / Noobite.

options.title: General - Repository button text
options.description: Text of the always-present repository button.

options.title: General - Repository button URL
options.description: URL opened by the repository button.

options.title: General - Overlay background color
options.description: Overlay background as #RRGGBB or #AARRGGBB.

options.title: General - Overlay outline color
options.description: Overlay outline as #RRGGBB or #AARRGGBB.

options.title: UI - Menu outline width (dp)
options.description: Width of the menu, monitor, and confirmation outlines, from 1 to 8dp.

options.title: UI - Legacy icon text
options.description: Text shown by the legacy icon. Maximum three characters.

options.title: UI - Legacy icon bold text
options.description: Use bold text in the legacy icon. Enabled by default.

options.title: UI - Legacy icon text color
options.description: Text color used by the legacy icon.

options.title: UI - Gradient background
options.description: Blend legacy icon background 1 into background 2. When disabled, only background 1 is used.

options.title: UI - Legacy icon background 1
options.description: First color of the legacy icon gradient.

options.title: UI - Legacy icon background 2
options.description: Second color of the legacy icon gradient. Background 1 is the existing overlay button background color.

options.title: UI - Legacy icon gradient angle (degrees)
options.description: Gradient direction: 0 degrees runs top to bottom, 90 runs left to right, and 30 runs diagonally down and right. Values wrap through 360 degrees.

options.title: UI - Icon outline
options.description: Add a separate outline around the legacy text icon. Disabled by default.

options.title: UI - Icon outline color
options.description: Color used only when the icon outline is enabled.

options.title: UI - Custom image icon
options.description: Select a local PNG, JPG, JPEG, or WebP image file. A valid image automatically replaces the legacy icon, including its outline. Prefer a transparent square image around 128x128 or 256x256 pixels. Images are embedded during patching and scaled proportionally. Leave blank or use an invalid file to fall back to the legacy icon with a one-time launch notice.

options.title: UI - Overlay button shape
options.description: Shape of the legacy text icon background.

options.title: UI - Overlay button size (dp)
options.description: Button size in density-independent pixels.

options.title: UI - Overlay button idle opacity (%)
options.description: Idle opacity from 10 to 100 percent. Higher values make the button less transparent.

options.title: UI - Overlay button fully visible duration (seconds)
options.description: How long the overlay button stays fully visible after dragging before fading to its idle opacity. The timer resets while dragging and starts again when the finger is released. Use a value from 1 to 10 seconds.

options.title: UI - Overlay button position
options.description: Initial floating button position.

options.title: Advanced - Overlay Activity name override
options.description: Optional fallback Activity class used only when Application startup cannot be found. Leave blank for universal automatic discovery. Example: com.example.MainActivity or Lcom/example/MainActivity;.

options.title: Settings to Modules - Activate statistic modules on launch
options.description: Start selected statistic modules as soon as the app launches. Active is disabled by default.

options.title: Settings to Modules - Enable monitors for statistic modules on launch
options.description: Show selected statistic monitors as soon as the app launches. Monitor is disabled by default.

options.title: Settings to Modules - Statistic monitor position
options.description: Show enabled statistic monitors from statistic modules above or below the overlay button.

options.title: Settings to Modules - Monitor panel size
options.description: Size multiplier for statistic monitor panels.

options.title: Settings to Modules - Monitor columns
options.description: Number of statistic monitor columns.

options.title: Settings to Modules - Temperature stat format
options.description: Temperature unit used by the Device Temperature menu value and monitor.

options.title: Settings to Modules - System time format
options.description: Clock format used by the System Time menu value and monitor. Timezone is shown in the menu value.

options.title: Statistic modules - Device Information
options.description: Include read-only phone and Android device information.

options.title: Statistic modules - FPS
options.description: Include the approximate display frame-rate statistic module.

options.title: Statistic modules - Device Temperature
options.description: Include battery-reported temperature in the selected temperature format.

options.title: Statistic modules - System Time
options.description: Include the phone system time statistic module.

options.title: Statistic modules - App Session Time
options.description: Include the in-process overlay session timer statistic module.

options.title: Statistic modules - Battery Status
options.description: Include the current battery percentage statistic module.

options.title: Statistic modules - App Memory Usage
options.description: Include approximate memory used by the current app process.

options.title: Statistic modules - Network Status
options.description: Include incoming and outgoing app network traffic monitors.

options.title: Activity modules - Keep screen awake
options.description: Include the keep-screen-awake activity module.

options.title: Activity modules - Fullscreen
options.description: Include the fullscreen activity module.

options.title: Activity modules - Allow screenshots
options.description: Include the allow-screenshots activity module.

options.title: Activity modules - App brightness
options.description: Include a per-Activity brightness slider.

options.title: Activity modules - Rotation mode
options.description: Include a per-Activity rotation mode selector.

options.title: Activity modules - App audio mute
options.description: Include a best-effort app audio mute toggle.

options.title: Hook modules - Disable haptic feedback / vibrations
options.description: Include a best-effort runtime haptic and vibration suppression module.

options.title: Hook modules - Disable app animations
options.description: Include a best-effort runtime animation suppression module.
